_comment: Per-repo path-list consumed by /to-issues AFK-fit checklist. Replace the placeholder repo slugs below with your own owner/repo. Adding a new repo MUST NOT require editing any SKILL.md — only this file. Paths are gitignore-style globs evaluated against an issue's declared-changed file list; an intersection => AFK-no => slice does NOT receive the `sandcastle` label and routes via interactive /implement. The first entry lists the framework's own Tier-2 sensitive files (mirrors docs/security/agent-boundaries.md — sync manually when that changes). The second entry is an example of protecting safety-critical zones in a second repo.
